_note: Qualitative findings from the CLI eval sweep of 2026-08-23, drawn from agent transcripts. Counts refresh from the API; these verbatim details do not.
environmentConfirmedHealthy: An agent ran `npm install -g @aisa-one/cli` (v0.3.0 installed), then `aisa whoami` and `aisa balance` — both succeeded, reporting $471.87 and unlimited. Auth and funding are working; none of the failures below are credential or balance related.

defects.title: Twitter community/social endpoints reject every request with a contract error
defects.evidence: An agent tried the documented form, a real community ID, --raw, the generic `aisa run twitter /community/tweets -q community_id=...` path, and every parameter spelling it could infer (ranking_mode, rankingMode, type, cursor). All returned `400: request does not match the endpoint contract`. Forcing POST returned `405 Method Not Allowed`. Its conclusion: "a server-side bug, not a usage error."
defects.action: Check the request contract for the community/* and social read endpoints against what the CLI sends. Every documented invocation currently fails.

defects.title: The CLI exits 0 when the API call failed
defects.evidence: 15 of 50 sampled failing runs contain some form of "Exit code 0, but the API returned a 400". Graders penalise this, but the real cost is that scripts and agents cannot detect failure.
defects.action: Return a non-zero exit code whenever the underlying HTTP call is not 2xx.

defects.title: Documented options are not implemented
defects.evidence: `aisa twitter community-tweets <id> --limit 5` returns `error: unknown option '--limit'`, so the agent fell back to --raw and then hit the 400.
defects.action: Reconcile the CLI's option parser with the documented flags.

defects.title: `aisa twitter space` returns 404
defects.evidence: Both sampled runs returned 404 / api endpoint not found.
defects.action: Confirm the endpoint exists and is routed, or remove the command.

defects.title: `aisa skills` subcommands fail or no-op
defects.evidence: `aisa skills remove lightsage-api-performance` prints `Skill not found in any agent directory.` and exits 0 — a no-op message rather than an error.
defects.action: Make skills subcommands report real state and fail loudly when they cannot act.
